title: Localized restriction and direct-image endpoint families
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme and fix derived categories of module sheaves on $Y$ and every localized open site [def-pc-derived-category]. For an open $W$, let $L_W$ be restriction to the localized site and let $G_W$ be its right adjoint (direct image), uniquely determined up to natural isomorphism. Define $J_W=R(G_W)\circ D(L_W)$. Let $P_W$ be the isomorphism closure in the localized derived category of the restrictions $D(L_W)(E)$ of perfect quasi-coherent objects $E$ [def-pc-perfect-complex]. For opens $A,B$, define $M_{A,B}$ to be the objects isomorphic to $J_A(E)\oplus J_B(E)$ for such an $E$, and $N_{A,B}$ to be objects isomorphic to $J_{A\cap B}(E)$ for such an $E$. These properties are on the ambient derived categories; no quasi-coherence of direct images is asserted.
